subject.title: fix(chat): preserve PNG attachments in native clients

question: Should native chat and share clients preserve PNG format and transparency, replacing the intentionally established always-JPEG upload policy?
rationale: The prior merged implementation and tests explicitly made JPEG normalization and alpha flattening part of the native attachment policy, so reversing that tradeoff between fidelity, payload size, and reliable delivery needs owner confirmation.

options.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
options.body: Approve PNG preservation, require adaptive sizing that never silently drops supported attachments, and retain metadata stripping across Android and Apple surfaces.

options.title: Keep JPEG normalization
options.body: Retain the existing predictable JPEG transport policy and close or narrow this PR rather than introducing format-dependent behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded PNGs
recommendation.body: Approve PNG preservation, require adaptive sizing that never silently drops supported attachments, and retain metadata stripping across Android and Apple surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Apple image-processing policy and its explicit JPEG/alpha expectations.
